name: RotaryMul

y.description: Output tensor with rotary position embedding applied, same shape and dtype as input

description:
Simple model that performs Rotary Position Embedding multiplication.
torch_npu.npu_rotary_mul(input, r1, r2, rotary_mode='half') -> Tensor

Pure PyTorch implementation (replacing torch_npu.npu_rotary_mul):
    if rotary_mode == 'half':
        half_d = input.shape[-1] // 2
        x1 = input[..., :half_d]
        x2 = input[..., half_d:]
        rotated = torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)
    elif rotary_mode == 'interleave':
        x1 = input[..., 0::2]
        x2 = input[..., 1::2]
        rotated = torch.stack((-x2, x1), dim=-1).flatten(-2)
    return input * r1 + rotated * r2
